scripts.test:unit: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --outDir node_modules/.cache/htest && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const path=require('node:path'); const { pathToFileURL } = require('node:url'); const root=path.resolve('node_modules/.cache/htest'); const tests=[]; const seen=new Set(); const walk=(dir)=>{for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true})) {const file=path.join(dir,entry.name); if (entry.isDirectory()) walk(file); else if (entry.name.endsWith('.test.js')) { const resolved=path.resolve(file); if (!seen.has(resolved)) { seen.add(resolved); tests.push(resolved); } }}}; walk(root); if (!tests.length) { console.error('No compiled tests found in ' + root); process.exit(1); } (async () => { for (const file of tests) await import(pathToFileURL(file).href); })().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exit(1); });"
